rationale:
Positives: The agent authenticated the user via full name + ZIP, matched a single account, reviewed orders, sought explicit confirmation before canceling, and executed the cancellations accordingly. The agent clarified the return request and confirmed no return from the delivered order before making any changes.

Issues leading to fail: The agent provided specific refund destinations and timing without tool support. It asserted refunds would go to PayPal, despite the account also having a gift card balance and without verifying which payment methods funded each order. It also gave a 5–7 business day refund window not supported by any tool output. Final refund amounts per order were presented without explicit tool-backed calculations in the transcript. These constitute providing information not supported by the tools/policy, which violates the requirement to avoid fabricating or assuming missing facts. Because correct final information is part of the pass bar, this results in a fail verdict.
